Subject: Catalyze Health — activation passband & kickoff alignment

Team — quick handoff note for Catalyze Health (signed last week). Key context below and a few asks so CS can take lead on kickoff and implementation: 

Deal snapshot:
- ARR: ~$240k/year with onboarding professional services (~$40k one-time).
- Primary use: embed generation + low-latency chat for clinician support across web portal.
- Compliance: customer requires SOC2 evidence and a short security questionnaire answered prior to prod.

Attachments: SOW_Catalyze_v1.pdf (draft), security_questionnaire_Catalyze.xlsx

Immediate asks for CS:
- Assign primary activation lead and owner for weekly sprint cadences (2–3 engineer touchpoints).
- Confirm kickoff window: week of Aug 16 preferred by Catalyze — Liam CC'd.
- Validate acceptance criteria in SOW page 2 (esp. staging SLA and data retention).

Risks/notes for handoff:
- They want a private VPC deployment for PHI-in-scope flows; procurement working on PO (procurement@catalyze.health).
- Expected pilot traffic: up to 50 QPS short bursts; we'll need to size Dedicated pool (recommend GPU mix note in Drive link).

Next steps:
1) Tessa / Ava — can you pick primary + secondary owners and confirm meeting invite?
2) Ben — I'll keep supporting procurement and scope clarifications; please loop infra if the VPC template needs customization.

Thanks — goal is a concise kickoff and a 30-day pilot acceptance window.

—Jonas

Thanks Jonas — taking this on. Quick notes from our side after scanning the SOW: 

Owners:
- Primary Activation Lead: Ava Chen (CSM) — ava.chen@redwoodinference.com
- Technical Onramp: Ben Carter (Solutions Lead) — ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

High-priority clarifications needed before kickoff:
- Staging SLA: is 99.5% during business hours acceptable for pilot? The current SOW wording is 99.9% — might be tight for a staging pool.
- VPC/network requirements: need their VPC CIDR and expected egress rules; that will affect our private deployment template.
- Data residency: confirm whether any PHI is written to persistent logs (they said no in call, but we need it in writing).

I'll schedule a 30-minute internal alignment with Ava and Ben today to hash out tasks and a kickoff agenda; will send a single consolidated invite to Liam/procurement once we confirm the internal checklist.

Tangent: we'll also complete the security questionnaire; can someone from sales (Jonas/Ben) confirm which contact at Catalyze owns encryption/KMS questions so we answer accurately?

Attachment: link to our internal activation checklist (see Drive link).

—Tessa

Thanks Jonas and Tessa — appreciate the quick responses. A couple quick items from procurement/ops so we can lock the Aug 16 kickoff: 

- Procurement has raised a PO that I'll attach once it's signed by legal; tentative PO id: CAT-PO-60810. Procurement contact for follow-up: procurement@catalyze.health.
- CIDR for our VPC (staging): 10.50.0.0/16. Egress allowed to 0.0.0.0/0 for outbound model calls; we'll provide a narrower list if needed.
- Regarding PHI: we will not forward patient-identifiable data during the pilot, but our logs will include hashed IDs — happy to sign a data handling attestation.

On the next steps: Aug 16 @ 10:00am PT works for a 45-minute kickoff. If you can send a calendar invite, we'll accept.

Attached: Catalyze_PO_20260810.pdf (will follow with signed copy).

—Liam

- Staging SLA: for pilot we'll accept 99.5% staging SLA; will reflect that in the SOW and send an updated SOW pdf by EOD tomorrow.
- KMS: we can support customer-managed keys; I'll loop infra once we have confirmation on encryption requirements.
